patients.persona: 54yo Male — Uncontrolled Type 2 Diabetes progressing to Neuropathy with Metformin titration

visits.transcript: doctor sahab mujhe diabetes hai aur baar baar peshab aata hai metformin ek goli subah shaam le raha hoon
ab baar baar peshab nahi hai par sugar high hai aur chakkar aana hota hai metformin dedh goli subah shaam kar dijiye
sugar high abhi bhi hai aur do hafte se paer mein jhanjhanahat shuru ho gayi hai metformin do goli aur vitamin b12 ek goli roz lijiye

patients.persona: 46yo Female — Hypertension + NSAID-induced Gastritis resolved after stopping Ibuprofen

visits.transcript: mera bp high rehta hai aur ghutne mein dard hai amlodipine ek goli aur ibuprofen ek goli le rahi hoon
bp high theek nahi hua amlodipine dedh goli karein aur pet mein gas banti hai aur seene mein jalan hai ibuprofen mat lijiye pantoprazole ek goli subah lein
ab seene mein jalan nahi hai aur pet mein gas nahi hai amlodipine dedh goli jaari rakhein
